text:
Now, we need to determine 4 out of 5 workers to complete one of the four tasks respectively. Due to each worker's different technical specialties, the time required for them to complete each task varies. The Hours required by each worker to complete each task are shown in Table 5-2.

Table 5-2
| Worker | $A$ | $B$ | $C$ | $D$ |
|--------|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| I      | 9   | 4   | 3   | 7   |
| II     | 4   | 6   | 5   | 6   |
| III    | 5   | 4   | 7   | 5   |
| IV     | 7   | 5   | 2   | 3   |
| V      | 10  | 6   | 7   | 4   |

Try to find a job assignment plan that minimizes the total working hours.

decisions.name: assign
decisions.description: Assign exactly 4 workers to 4 tasks (one worker per task, one task per worker)

model.sets:
workers = [I, II, III, IV, V]
tasks = [A, B, C, D]
model.objective: minimize sum(w in workers, t in tasks) time[w,t] * x[w,t]
model.constraints:
C1: sum(w in workers) x[w,t] = 1  for t in tasks
C2: sum(t in tasks) x[w,t] <= 1  for w in workers
C3: sum(w in workers, t in tasks) x[w,t] = 4
